The depot is Southgate. I've replied to you in a thread on your message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

The outage was on 3 Sep 2025. Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. In her note closing the incident at 18:43 that day, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog once labels were printing again.

Two things to know before the call:
- Her first message says "depots", plural, but Southgate is the only one she named.
- I couldn't find an address or city for Southgate in that channel, your other channels or the shared files. Priyanka is the best person to confirm the location.
